process.commandLine: powershell -NoProfile -Command "'sandbox PID: ' + $PID; $c = New-Object Net.Sockets.TcpClient; $c.Connect('1.1.1.1', 443); 'connected 1.1.1.1:443 from local port ' + $c.Client.LocalEndPoint.Port + ' - holding 15 s'; Start-Sleep 15; $c.Close(); $h = New-Object Net.Sockets.TcpClient; try { if ($h.ConnectAsync('127.0.0.1', 18080).Wait(3000)) { 'host loopback :18080: CONNECTED' } else { 'host loopback :18080: timed out' } } catch { 'host loopback :18080: BLOCKED' } finally { $h.Close() }"
